\(\overrightarrow{x} \times \overrightarrow{y} = \begin{vmatrix} \widehat{i} & \widehat{j} & \widehat{k} \\ 3 & -6 & -1 \\ 1 & 4 & -3 \end{vmatrix} = \widehat{i}(18 + 4) - \widehat{j}(-9 + 1) + \widehat{k}(12 + 6) = 22\widehat{i} + 8\widehat{j} + 18\widehat{k}\).

\(|\overrightarrow{z}| = \sqrt{3^{2} + 4^{2} + 12^{2}} = \sqrt{169} = 13\).

The projection of \(\overrightarrow{x} \times \overrightarrow{y}\) on \(\overrightarrow{z}\) is \(\frac{(22)(3) + (8)(-4) + (18)(-12)}{13} = \frac{66 - 32 - 216}{13} = \frac{-182}{13} = -14\), so its magnitude is 14. Hence (C).
